<td class="text">Goodwill and&#160;Intangible Assets<div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">During the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, the Company performed its annual impairment test of goodwill and determined that there were no impairments of goodwill identified as of the impairment test date. The Company&#8217;s goodwill was&#160;$76,423 as of September&#160;30, 2026 and June&#160;30, 2026.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">During the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, the Company performed its annual impairment test of identifiable indefinite-lived intangible assets and determined that there were no impairments identified as of the impairment test date. The Company&#8217;s indefinite-lived intangible assets were $20,378 as of September&#160;30, 2026 and June&#160;30, 2026, which consisted of the Company&#8217;s sports franchises.</span></div><span></span>
